correctness.rationale: For each finite reflexive transitive upward-directed frame R, quotienting by mutual reachability gives a finite directed poset whose every successor cone has a unique greatest terminal strongly connected class T_R(w). Thus diamond box X iff T_R(w) subset X and H_R(X) iff T_R(w) subset X while R(w) is not subset X. The positive H truth sets recover nonterminal worlds, the intersection of such X recovers T_R(w), and truth on W\{u} reconstructs every nonterminal successor outside T. Terminal classes visible from them are also determined. Remaining invisible terminal vertices U can be partitioned into arbitrary equivalence classes with no change in H, and no other relation is free: fiber size Bell(|U|). Each visible weak component consists of nonempty terminal T plus arbitrary preorder on D and all D-to-T edges; labelled exponential formula yields exp(x+(e^x−1)(P(x)−1)). My independent brute enumeration of all labelled S4.2 relations on n=1..4 recovers frame/operator counts (1,1),(4,3),(26,22),(255,229), including Bell fiber distribution; general proof is symbolic.

value.rationale: The exact reconstruction/fiber theorem quantifies identifiability of the underlying finite preorder from the full mere-belief truth-set operator. Determining the number and structure of indistinguishable models is a natural information-loss question in modal neighborhood semantics; a Bell-number fiber classification plus quotient generating function is substantive beyond generic expressivity or preorder counting.
